subject.title: feat(agents): sessions_search tool for full-text recall over past session transcripts

question: After the two correctness blockers are fixed, should `sessions_search` and `sessions.search` become permanent core tool and protocol surfaces rather than remain experimental or plugin-owned?
rationale: This adds an always-available core agent capability, a public gateway method, persisted schema, and a plugin-SDK parameter; the protected `maintainer` label and linked issue's product-decision state require explicit ownership judgment.

options.title: Approve the core surface
options.body: Land the corrected tool, gateway API, persisted index, and SDK addition as the canonical exact-recall path.

options.title: Stage the capability
options.body: Keep the implementation experimental or internal until its public contract and operational lifecycle have stronger production proof.

options.title: Move recall outside core
options.body: Route exact transcript recall through an optional plugin or existing memory capability instead of adding permanent core surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve the core surface
recommendation.body: Land the corrected tool, gateway API, persisted index, and SDK addition as the canonical exact-recall path.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened and implemented the feature and has recent merged ownership across the session storage and gateway surfaces involved.
